title: Triggers: a History list of every firing and whether context dropped afterwards, kept for one week
story: The Triggers panel now ends with a History section kept for one week. Each firing shows the trigger, the terminal that hit the level, the percent, who got the message and whether it arrived, and a green follow-up line appears when a recipient's context drops again. Clicking a trigger's 'Last fired' line filters the History, and Clear history empties it. Before, only the last firing was shown, in memory, and it was lost on restart.

checks.criterion: A firing writes one line, and a failed send shows its error
checks.steps: Open two terminals in a made-up project 'shop' and tick both in the Injector. Add a trigger 'Compact reminder' at 5% that sends to every terminal it watches. Close one terminal, then use the other until it passes 5%.
checks.expected: Under History: today's date, a group headed with '· shop', then 'HH:MM Compact reminder: N%, sent to …'; a failed send is red and names the error; hovering shows the start of the message.

checks.criterion: One follow-up line after context drops
checks.steps: After a firing, run /clear in the terminal that got the message, then let context drop again.
checks.expected: One green line under that terminal's group, 'HH:MM context dropped to N% (worked)'; a second drop adds no further line.

checks.criterion: Grouping by day then terminal, newest first, trigger filter and Clear history
checks.steps: With two triggers that have fired, click one row's 'Last fired …' line, pick 'All triggers', then click Clear history.
checks.expected: First only that trigger's lines, then all, then 'No firings in the last week.'; a deleted trigger shows in the filter as 'name (deleted)'.

checks.criterion: Lines survive a restart and are dropped after seven days
checks.steps: Fire a trigger, quit Maestro, start it again.
checks.expected: The History still lists that firing; lines older than seven days are gone.
